name: test_nap_two_adjacent_notes_writes_pair_and_unlinks

name: test_first_unlink_sees_both_parent_files
doc: At the first child unlink, both parent .summ and .tree already exist.

name: test_tree_replace_failure_leaves_children
doc: If parent .tree replace fails, both notes remain and no nap pair is left.

name: test_nap_rejects_empty_caption
doc: An empty caption is rejected and the store is unchanged.

name: test_nap_rejects_overlong_caption
doc: A caption over ENTRY_CHARS is rejected and the store is unchanged.

name: test_nap_overlong_caption_message_is_a_ratchet
doc: An over-long nap caption names actual UTF-8 bytes, the limit, and the compress hint.

name: test_nap_rejects_unknown_id

doc: A view nap with no .tree raises unknown id and does not say to copy from wake.

doc: A nap of two naps stores NapChild nodes and the union of original digests.

doc: Napping a child whose .summ is missing stores an empty NapChild.sum.

name: test_napchild_sum_empty_when_child_sum_conflict
doc: Napping a child whose .summ is conflict-marked stores an empty NapChild.sum.

doc: Two adjacent notes with the same text share an id and can still be napped.

name: test_write_nap_disjoint_adjacent_naps_still_concat

doc: Two identical-text notes still concat; the overlap guard requires a nap.

name: test_write_nap_malformed_tree_raises_unreadable_pack

name: test_resolve_inside_started_dir_is_that_store
doc: Resolve from inside a started directory returns that directory.

name: test_resolve_path_file_walks_from_parent
doc: An existing file path walks from the file's parent directory.

name: test_resolve_missing_file_walks_from_parent
doc: A missing file path walks from its parent directory.

name: test_resolve_omitted_path_uses_cwd
doc: Omitting path_arg walks from cwd.

doc: start <dir> creates a store in that directory.

doc: start does not create .summem on ancestor directories.

name: test_start_without_dir_is_usage
doc: start without a directory exits nonzero.

doc: note --path under an unstarted sibling writes to the git-root store.

name: test_nap_zoom_recall_path_use_started_store
doc: nap, zoom, and recall --path operate on the child store only.

name: test_note_path_fold_request_is_copy_paste_safe
doc: A fold request after note --path is a command that naps that store from $PWD.

doc: WAKE_LINES in one store's config does not change another store's budget.

name: test_config_entry_chars_is_per_store_for_notes_and_naps
doc: ENTRY_CHARS applies per store to notes and nap captions, including above 280.

name: test_unreadable_config_uses_defaults
doc: Unreadable config.toml uses defaults and is not rewritten.

name: test_monkeypatch_wake_lines_still_applies_when_config_omits_knob
doc: Omitted WAKE_LINES still follows the module constant, including a monkeypatch.

name: test_empty_root_omits_project_root_header

doc: wake --path omits the Usage section.

name: test_root_wake_catalogs_other_store

doc: First wake in a git repo with no store creates the store and prints nothing.

name: test_wake_lists_two_notes_sorted_by_filename

name: test_wake_pack_line_has_no_date
doc: A pack wake line has grain and prefix and contains no YYYY-MM-DD.

doc: A grain-1 pack (kind nap, leaves 1) prints the caption only.

name: test_format_wake_line_empty_note_caption_keeps_trailing_colon
doc: A note with an empty caption prints x1 day: with no extra space.

name: test_resolve_id_rejects_hyphenated_day
doc: A YYYY-MM-DD token is not a content-id prefix.

name: test_wake_output_omits_notes_naps_and_git
doc: Wake output does not mention notes/, naps/, or git.

name: test_wake_skips_unreadable_note_and_still_prints
doc: An unreadable note is skipped; readable notes still print.

name: test_wake_skips_dot_prefixed_temp_file
doc: A leftover dot-prefixed temp file in notes/ is not listed.

name: test_wake_mixed_view_sorts_by_filename
doc: A nap and a later loose note sort by filename; grain comes from the name.

name: test_wake_missing_sum_prints_id_and_grain_without_caption
doc: Missing .summ: wake prints id and grain, not a caption, and does not refuse.

name: test_wake_conflict_sum_omits_caption
doc: A .summ containing <<<<<<< omits the caption and still prints id and grain.

name: test_wake_does_not_call_loads_tree
doc: At-budget wake lists files and does not open .tree.

name: test_wake_pack_line_is_grain_prefix_caption
doc: A pack wake line is xN prefix: caption.

name: test_wake_prints_at_most_wake_lines_newest
doc: Eleven notes at WAKE_LINES=4 print the newest four texts, no hashes.

name: test_wake_does_not_print_a_nap_request
doc: Wake never prints Run: or a nap invocation, even when over budget.

name: test_short_id_is_8_hex_when_unique

name: test_short_id_lengthens_until_unique
doc: short_id grows past 8 hex when two ids share the floor prefix.

name: test_resolve_id_returns_full_id_for_unique_prefix
doc: resolve_id maps a unique prefix to the full id.

name: test_resolve_id_rejects_ambiguous_or_unknown_prefix
doc: resolve_id raises ValueError when the prefix matches none or many ids.

name: test_short_id_is_8_hex_when_id_repeats
doc: A repeated content id still shortens to 8 hex; uniqueness is among distinct ids.

name: test_resolve_id_accepts_prefix_when_id_repeats
doc: resolve_id treats a repeated content id as one identity, not an ambiguous clash.

name: test_note_rejects_empty
doc: Empty note text is rejected.

name: test_note_rejects_over_280_bytes
doc: A note longer than 280 UTF-8 bytes is rejected.

name: test_note_overlong_message_is_a_ratchet
doc: An over-long note names actual UTF-8 bytes, the limit, and the compress hint.

name: test_note_rejects_newline
doc: A note containing a newline or carriage return is rejected.

name: test_note_accepts_280_bytes
doc: A note of exactly 280 UTF-8 bytes is accepted.

name: test_note_280_is_utf8_bytes_not_chars
doc: The 280 limit is UTF-8 bytes, not characters.

name: test_note_rejects_non_utc_now
doc: A naive or non-UTC now is rejected.

name: test_first_note_creates_config_and_notes

name: test_ensure_store_does_not_create_driver

name: test_existing_driver_is_not_overwritten

name: test_ensure_store_creates_naps_dir
doc: ensure_store creates naps/ and does not overwrite an existing driver.

name: test_note_name_uses_injected_utc_clock_and_rand
doc: Note names use the injected UTC clock and rng bytes.

name: test_same_second_notes_are_two_paths
doc: Two notes in the same UTC second still produce two paths.

name: test_version_prints_script_version
doc: main(['version']) exits 0 and prints __version__ plus a newline.

name: test_version_outside_repository_writes_nothing
doc: version outside a repository exits 0 and creates no store.

name: test_version_rejects_extra_args
doc: version with an extra token exits nonzero.

name: test_version_rejects_path_flag
doc: version --path is rejected; version -h does not list --path.

name: test_help_before_version_prints_version_help
doc: -h version prints version help, not top-level-only usage.

name: test_version_line_has_release_please_marker
doc: Repo-root summem __version__ carries x-release-please-version.

name: test_version_matches_release_please_manifest

name: test_release_config_generic_extra_file_is_summem
doc: release-please generic extra-files targets repo-root summem.

doc: surgery.py and summem print the same in-script version (lockstep, not enforced at runtime).

name: test_surgery_version_line_has_release_please_marker
doc: Repo-root surgery.py __version__ carries x-release-please-version.

name: test_release_config_generic_extra_files_include_surgery
doc: release-please generic extra-files also bump repo-root surgery.py.

name: test_same_pair_two_captions_conflict_only_on_sum
doc: Two nappers of the same pair conflict on .summ only; both resolutions wake and zoom.

name: test_view_includes_nap_stem_when_sum_has_conflict_markers
doc: A .summ containing <<<<<<< is still one view node.
